caption: A curtain is drawn along its rail to one side, and the fabric gathers into deep folds as it bunches at the end.

sa.check: A curtain hangs on a rail.
It is drawn along the rail to one side.
The fabric gathers into deep folds at the end.
The drawing comes first and the folds deepen after.

pc.expect: The folds grow deeper and closer as more curtain arrives, the fabric keeps its length, and it does not pass through itself.
pc.fail: It passes through itself; or grows; or the folds do not deepen.

pc.expect: The soft cloth folds and the hem hangs.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or stretches; or tears.
It rises; or floats; or stands out sideways.

pc.expect: It moves only as it is drawn.
pc.fail: It moves by itself; or slides back; or jumps.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The curtain's colour and the window stay the same.
pc.fail: The curtain changes colour; or the rail changes; or the room rearranges.

note: The hand is kept as the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
